_doc: PATV premium PAD cosmetics catalog (padcosmetics.js, 1.99ew). Items belong to a PAD (not a user): its owner buys them for 100% Fort Knox, anyone signed in can gift one (50% Fort Knox / 50% the pad's room vault). Keep ids stable - owned copies point at them. price: PAT; when it's missing the item costs its rarity's price in cosmetics.json's rarities table (common 25k, uncommon 75k, rare 250k, epic 750k). season {from, to (UTC dates, to exclusive), label}: a time-limited item - it sells only inside that window (a pad that bought one keeps it). retired: true stops sales without touching owned copies. style.fx is the CSS effect (public/css/padfx.css: pfx-f-<fx> frames, pfx-g-<fx> glows); badges carry their text + icon. animated: true = the effect moves (it stops under prefers-reduced-motion). perk: prime_time (1.99iv) = never sold, the pad has it while it has Prime Time (premium.js).
